description: Average Annual Daily Traffic (AADT) Counts at Point Locations on the DTI Highway Network / Comptages du trafic moyen journalier annuel (TMJA) à des points précis du réseau routier MTI is a dataset listed in Province of New Brunswick open data portal (gnb.socrata.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Province of New Brunswick. This dataset shows the average annual daily traffic (AADT) counts at specific point locations on the DTI highway network. Data was collected in 2023. / Cet ensemble de données présente les comptages du trafic moyen journalier annuel (TMJA) à des points précis du réseau routier de MTI. Les données ont été collectées en 2023. Coverage: New Brunswick. The portal files it under the category Roads, Driving and Transport. Its tags are traffic map, traffic, nb traffic volumes, tmja, volumes de trafic routier nb. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation and Infrastructure / Ministère des Transports et de. The portal shows 2026-05-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is New Brunswick Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-gnb-socrata-com-portal.
